Jelly Technical are recruiting for a leading manufacturing business based in Leek who are looking for a dedicated IT Support & Systems Technician to join their team.   • Manage the complete IT on boarding and off boarding process for joiners, movers and leavers, including full equipment setup and access configuration.
  • Monitor endpoint security, assist with basic network troubleshooting and provide essential support for Microsoft 365 applications and core business systems.
  • Maintain accurate records of all company IT assets.
 

Experience and Qualifications needed for this IT support Technician role:

  • Prior experience in a dedicated IT support, helpdesk or systems support role

  • Proven ability to diagnose basic technical issues and a structured approach to problem-solving in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong customer service skills with the unique ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical staff.

Jelly Technical are seeking a proactive Quality Assurance Technician to join a forward-thinking manufacturing site in Leek. You will act as a key technical champion and ensures that every product leaving the facility meets the highest standards of safety, quality and compliance.

You will collaborate closely with shop floor teams to ensure technical excellence in product quality, food safety and regulatory compliance. You will support internal audits and environmental monitoring programmes, reporting anomalies when they arise.

Role and responsibilities of this Quality Assurance Technician:

  • Conduct essential site audits including GMP, glass, hard plastic, and critical control points.
  • Execute environmental testing schedules such as line swabs, water sampling and allergen validation.
  • Conduct weekly chemical dosing checks, titrations and routine instrument calibrations.
  • Support any internal investigations on any non-conformance's.
  • Assist in collecting and reporting crucial data.

Experience and qualifications needed for this Quality Assurance Technician:

  • Level 3 qualification in Food Safety & Hygiene.
  • Level 2 HACCP certification.
  • Previous experience in a food manufacturing role.
  • Knowledge of GMP, BRCGS standard, and factory compliance requirements.
  • An understanding of allergen management and environmental swabbing protocols.
  • Exposure to audit processes.
  • Strong numeracy, literacy and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills to style to collaborate effectively across all shift levels.

Benefits to you as a Quality Assurance Technician:

  • Salary negotiable depending on experience
  • Monday to Friday
  • Shift Pattern: 6am-2pm and 2pm-10pm

job.title: Maintenance Engineer
job.description:
Jelly Technical are seeking a Multi-Skilled Maintenance Engineer to join a leading food manufacturing facility in Leicester. In this role, you will play a vital part in ensuring the efficiency, safety and continuous improvement of the production lines. This position is ideal for a proactive engineer who thrives in a busy environment.

Working a 4 on 4 off shift pattern you will be responsible for both planned preventative maintenance and breakdowns, helping us minimise downtime and maintain high standards of quality.

If you have a critical repairs engineering background from the armed forces, another industry or recently completed your apprenticeship, we would welcome you to apply as there is an opportunity for you to grow and develop your career with support and training.

Role and responsibilities of this Multi Skilled Maintenance Engineer role:

  • Respond swiftly to critical breakdowns to deliver effective solutions and repairs.
  • Complete scheduled PPM’s.
  • Be proactive in looking at root cause analysis to improve reliability of the plat machinery.
  • Maintain complete and accurate data logs within the CMMS.
  • Adhere strictly to all site Health and Safety protocols, hygiene regulations and quality standards.
  • Collaborate with production and the engineering shift lead regarding daily workloads.

Experience needed for this Multi Skilled Maintenance Engineer role:

  • Apprentice trained or time served – multi skilled.
  • Background as a maintenance engineer (any industry will be considered)
  • Solid awareness and practical understanding of industrial Health & Safety standards.
  • Self-motivated individual capable of working effectively on your own initiative or within a team.
  • Adaptable and flexible approach to business demands and seasonal fluctuations

Benefits to you as a Multi Skilled Maintenance Engineer:

  • Salary: £47,000 per annum (plus 5% Night Shift Allowance).
  • Shift Pattern: 4 on 4 off rotating Days and Nights, 6am – 6pm and 6pm – 6am.
  • Company pension scheme.
  • Ongoing training and career development opportunities.

Apply TODAY to express an interest. A member of the Jelly Technical team will endeavour to contact all suitable applicants within 72 hours.

job.title: Multi Skilled Maintenance Engineer
job.description:
An award-winning British food manufacturer with over a century of craftsmanship is seeking a Multi-Skilled Maintenance Engineer to join their dedicated team. Operating as a successful business they combine traditional values with modern engineering to produce premium products which they distribute globally. The role is based at a well-invested facility, easily commutable from Nottingham, Melton Mowbray and Grantham.

This position offers a refreshing change from typical manufacturing environments by prioritising proactive equipment reliability over high-pressure reactive maintenance. Operating on a Monday to Friday double days shift pattern, you will maintain specialised production machinery and support capital project installations.

Role and responsibilities of the Multi Skilled Maintenance Engineer role:

  • Carry out robust PPM schedules and review them for effectiveness.
  • Respond promptly to machinery breakdowns to implement effective repairs.
  • Identify, develop and implement improvement projects across the site's equipment.
  • Utilise Root Cause Analysis techniques to prevent recurring engineering issues.
  • Support the installation and commissioning of new equipment and capital projects.
  • Work under the guidance of the shift lead, completing all allocated tasks efficiently.
  • Document all completed works, reports and data accurately.
  • Adhere strictly to all Health & Safety procedures, hygiene standards and company rules.

Qualifications and experience needed for this Multi Skilled Maintenance Engineer role

  • Ideally apprentice-trained as a Multi-Skilled Engineer or Time Served Engineer.
  • Proven engineering experience working within a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong, up-to-date awareness of workplace Health & Safety legislation and procedures.
  • Adaptable and flexible mindset to meet seasonal business demands and fluctuating production requirements.
  • High self-motivation with the ability to work independently using your own initiative.
  • Industrious work ethic with the capability to perform effectively under pressure.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Eligible to work in the UK with the relevant right to work documentation.

Benefits to you of this multi-skilled maintenance engineer role

  • Salary of up to £41,500 per annum.
  • Annual Company Profit Related Bonus.
  • Pension scheme – 8% matched.
  • Annual holiday entitlement of 25 days plus bank holidays.
  • Canteen and on-site shop
  • Life Assurance coverage.
  • Access to rewards and savings portal for retail discounts.
  • Monday to Friday working hours (6am-2pm and 2pm-10pm)
  • Opportunity to work with custom-developed packaging and processing technology.

Apply TODAY to express an interest. A member of the Jelly Technical team will endeavour to contact all suitable applicants within 72 hours.
